features.name: is_odor_pleasant_or_none
features.description: Binary indicator for mushrooms with no odor, almond odor, or anise odor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong linear separation margin as these specific odors are highly discriminative in traditional foraging.

features.name: is_gill_size_narrow
features.description: Binary indicator for mushrooms with narrow gills.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to assign a specific weight to the narrow gill characteristic, which is a key morphological trait.

features.name: has_bruises
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the mushroom bruises.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bruising is a significant biochemical reaction; this feature provides a direct linear indicator for the model.

features.name: is_spore_print_color_dark
features.description: Binary indicator for dark spore print colors (black, brown, chocolate).
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups similar dark spore prints together, reducing dimensionality and providing a robust feature for the linear margin.

features.name: stalk_surface_smoothness_score
features.description: A composite score from 0.0 to 1.0 indicating the smoothness of the stalk above and below the ring.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous-like severity measure of stalk smoothness, which is more effective for linear SVMs than separate categorical indicators.

features.name: is_ring_type_pendant
features.description: Binary indicator for mushrooms with a pendant ring type.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates the most common ring type, allowing the model to learn a specific linear weight for this structural feature.

features.name: gill_color_brightness_score
features.description: A mapped score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing the relative brightness of the gill color, from dark (black/brown) to bright (white/yellow/pink).
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a high-cardinality categorical feature into a smooth, ordinal-like projection suitable for linear models.

features.name: population_density_score
features.description: An ordinal score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing the density of the mushroom population, from abundant/scattered to clustered/several.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes population density as a continuous severity measure, providing a monotonic feature for the SVM margin.

features.name: habitat_woods_or_grasses
features.description: Binary indicator for mushrooms found in woods, grasses, or paths.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups common habitats together, creating a stable linear feature that captures typical environmental conditions.

features.name: stalk_color_uniformity
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the stalk color is the same above and below the ring.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a morphological symmetry trait, providing a derived interaction feature that a linear model cannot learn directly from raw categories.

features.name: semantic_foraging_risk_score
features.description: A semantic judgment of the mushroom's overall risk profile for foragers based on its visual and olfactory characteristics, such as odor, gill color, and stalk surface.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, continuous risk assessment that aggregates multiple categorical traits into a single, powerful linear predictor.

features.name: semantic_culinary_safety_confidence
features.description: A semantic judgment of the confidence in the mushroom's safety for culinary use based on traditional foraging heuristics, evaluating features like bruises, ring type, and spore print color.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a complementary, continuous confidence score that helps the linear SVM establish a robust decision boundary based on expert-like heuristics.
